values.note: DCNR state forest motorized campsite rate (a state forest program, not a state park one). The $6.50 reservation fee is non-refundable and charged once per booking.

fees.source: ReserveAmerica's price block on every site page of this entry for one night (read 2026-11-10): 'Residents of PA $10.00 Per Night, $70.00 Per Week', 'Non-Residents $15.00 Per Night, $105.00 Per Week', 'Reservation Fees $6.50'. https://www.pa.gov/agencies/dcnr/recreation/what-to-do/stay-overnight/overnight-prices-and-policies ('Motorized roadside, hike-in roadside, equestrian, and rustic campsites can be reserved for a fee of $10.00 a night for Pennsylvania residents and $15.00 a night for non-residents')

values.note: Check-in and check-out are 3 pm. After a stay, 48 hours off state forest land before camping again.

note: Two gravel pull-ins on Clear Run Road in the Callen Run Tract, about half a mile apart, each with a picnic table and fire ring, under tree canopy: Clear Run 2 is about 0.9 mile down Clear Run Road and Clear Run 1 about 1.5 miles. From PA 28 the way in is Egypt Road, Richardsville Road and Fire Tower Road, a forest road; Clear Run Road leaves it at 1.8 miles. The agency warns that four-wheel drive or tire chains may be needed in winter conditions. Pack out trash. State forest roads are not plowed in winter. --Claude
